dependency_order: A `technical-report` seeds prerequisites before methods, evidence, and claims that use them (§4.4).

slots.name: Summary
slots.description: Main result or deliverable, scope, audience, and headline evidence in assumed-reader vocabulary.

slots.name: Context
slots.description: Question, need, prior state, and constraints.

slots.name: System or method
slots.description: What was built, examined, or done; interfaces, configuration, and mechanism at the detail needed for audit.

slots.name: Evidence
slots.description: Measurements, observations, comparisons, or worked cases with the reporting elements required by Part 5.

slots.name: Interpretation
slots.description: What the evidence supports, separated from observation and calibrated per §5.6.

slots.name: Limitations
slots.description: Scope, failure modes, missing evidence, and what was not tested.

slots.name: Reproducibility or verification
slots.description: Use reproducibility when another reader can repeat the method. Use verification when claims are checked against a system or artifact. State the steps, inputs, and pass criteria. A report may include both.
